policy.head: unchanged original vocabulary output embeddings; no project decision head
policy.probability_semantics: next-token distribution conditional on an offered A-D token; not task-success probability
policy.prompt: unchanged full standard policy_request rendered by the existing native baseline prompt; official chat template, enable_thinking=False
policy.forced_singletons: Code action; no model forward; consumes one controller RNG draw

selection.rule: Two outcome-selected illustrations from the frozen unified evaluation. Maze uses a successful 16x16 OOD run; Snake uses a 12x12 test run where NanoJev reaches the food target sooner. Both retain Jev's real successes and Untuned Qwen's real failures. Full test and OOD aggregates use every navigation case, separately from these illustrations.
selection.aggregate_scope: Every frozen Maze/Snake case, with test and OOD reported separately
